data.title: 青山七海 · 樱花庄和室的台词本晚自习
data.action: 规规矩矩地正坐在榻榻米座垫上，两手捧着荧光笔划满记号的声优试音台词本，马尾辫已经拆开，神情专注认真中透着少女的倔强
data.location: 樱花庄二楼七海的和室房间
data.lighting: 矮桌上小台灯聚焦在翻开的剧本上，暖色光圈衬托出少女素颜的清秀白皙
data.camera: high angle, side view, medium shot
data.mood: 刻苦坚韧、青涩倔强与让人心疼的努力
data.description: 破旧却充满回忆的樱花庄和室。青山七海结束了便利店的打工，换上一件洗得发软的蜜桃粉条纹纯棉睡裙。平日紧扎的高马尾在就寝前拆开，柔顺的长发散在肩侧。她正坐在小圆桌前，用荧光笔一遍遍核对声优养成所的试音台词，嘴里小声念诵着发音练习，眼神满是不服输的倔强——「神田同学……？呜哇，你怎么直接进来了！等、等一下，我还在练习明天的台词呢……不准笑话我的大阪腔啦！」
data.promptProse: Sitting neatly on a tatami cushion at her low wooden desk late at night in Sakurasou, Nanami Aoyama wears a comfortable peach-and-white striped cotton henley nightdress with her hair loose. Holding a script marked with highlighter lines, she looks up with a dedicated, gently flustered blush under the warm pool of her desk lamp.
data.animaCaption: Sitting neatly in seiza on a tatami cushion with her hair let down in a peach-and-white striped cotton nightdress, she holds her marked audition script and looks up with a tired, earnest blush. A small desk lamp pools warm focus across the pages.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a loose peach-and-white striped cotton dorm nightdress with a modest buttoned henley neckline and side pockets.
